name: Don Stroud
bio: ​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Donald Lee Stroud (born 1 September 1943) is an American actor and surfer who appeared in many films in the 1960s, 1970s and 1980s, and has starred in over 100 movies and 175 television shows to date.
